data.name: Kenyon
data.gender_notes: Kenyon is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Kenos' meaning empty and 'Yon' meaning young. In ancient Greek culture, the name Kenyon was given to boys born during a time of peace and prosperity. The name Kenyon carries the meaning “Youthful, Noble” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kenyon usually hope their child will grow to embody youthful, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kenyon belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Youthful, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kenyon total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
